about: DRAFT, never run. Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B (qwen35moe: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B architecture, 3B active) at Q8_0 from ornith-ai's own GGUF repository, with its BF16 image projector (qwen3vl_merger) and its built-in MTP layer as the draft (draft-mtp, 3 tokens, as in the RTX 5070 and Arc B70 Ornith launches), all on the RTX Spark N1X's GPU. Q8_0 rather than the Q4_K_M/Q5_K_M other cards run, since memory is ample here. Upstream llama.cpp b11718 (qwen35moe and qwen3vl_merger are both in llama-arch.cpp / clip-impl.h at that tag). --load-mode none as in the other N1X launches. Ornith's recommended general sampling (temperature 0.6, top-p 0.95, top-k 20). Only 10 of 40 layers are attention (2 KV heads x 256) plus the MTP layer, so the KV is 22 KB a token: 262,144 tokens is 5.5 GiB f16, so the card's default KV type stays.
setup: One RTX Spark N1X. 38.7 GB of downloads (37.80 GB Q8_0 GGUF + 0.90 GB mmproj). Expected resident memory ~43 GiB at 262,144 tokens (36.0 GiB weights, 5.5 GiB f16 KV, compute buffers), so the desktop keeps plenty. No network at runtime: the MTP head is inside the GGUF.
